ask: can u make a wrapped card from this chat, msgs per person, most used word, busiest time
sentence: A shared recap card where each person enters their own message count, most used word and busiest hour, and the card shows bars per person, the top word and the busiest time.
use_when: A group wants a year-end or period recap card of their chat
People want to compare message counts side by side
The group wants to pick a most used word and busiest time together
Someone asks for a wrapped-style summary of a chat
dont_use_when: The group needs a plain poll or vote on a decision
The numbers must be counted automatically from the chat history
The group wants a game, quiz or score tracker
